chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Jameel ibn Darraj, from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the two arms of the woman, are they from the adornment of which Allah (Blessed and High is He) said: 'and let them not display their adornment except to their husbands'?
He (peace be upon him) said: 'Yes, and what is below the headscarf is from the adornment, and what is below the two bracelets.'
ai.seo_question: Are a woman's arms considered part of her adornment (zinah) that must be covered in prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the two arms constitute 'adornment' (zinah) based on Surah An-Nur, thereby extending the Quranic command to conceal beauty beyond just the face and feet. The Imam further specifies that the area below the headscarf and the wrists (below the bracelets) are included in this category, establishing a scholarly consensus on the modesty of the limbs. This hadith is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for defining the boundaries of female 'awrah in relation to non-mahram men, linking physical coverage directly to the concept of visual modesty.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Al Fuzayl Bin Yasaar who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the two arms from the woman, are these two from the ornaments which Allahazwj Blessed and High Speaks of [24:31] and not display their ornaments except to their husbands?’
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, and whatever is besides the scarf is from the adornment, and whatever is besides the two bracelets’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ibn Mahbub from Jamil ibn Darraj from Fudayl ibn Yasar who has said the following: “This is concerning my question before abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the arms of women if they are of beautification about which Allah, most Blessed, most High, has said, . . they must not expose their beauty except for their husband.’ [24:32]
He (the Imam) said, ’Yes, whatever must be covered with the scarf is of their beauty and whatever is above their bracelet is of their beauty.’”
